text: The Aurore Current Account is Crédit Aurore's core payment account for retail customers resident in the European Union. It can be opened online or in branch upon presentation of a valid identity document and proof of address, subject to the identity verification required under anti-money-laundering rules. Account maintenance costs EUR 2.40 per month, that is EUR 28.80 per year, and is free for customers under 25 and for holders of the Aurore Premium Package. The account is issued with a SEPA-compatible IBAN, allowing euro payments and the sending and receiving of SEPA credit transfers across the thirty-six SEPA countries. Included services cover real-time balance and transaction viewing through the mobile app and online banking, free monthly electronic statements, and SMS alerts charged at EUR 0.30 each beyond the bundled allowance. An authorised overdraft of up to EUR 2,000 can be arranged for customers with regular income, at an annual debit rate of 8.50 percent. Cash withdrawals at Aurore network ATMs are free and unlimited; outside the network, four withdrawals per month are free, after which each is charged EUR 1. Payments within the euro area are free of charge, and under EU rules cross-border euro payments are charged the same as domestic ones. The account can be linked to a Visa Classic or Visa Premier card, an Aurore Savings account and lending products. Closing the account is free of charge and can be requested by the customer at any time without notice, in line with consumer protection law.

The Aurore Savings account is a flexible instant-access savings product offered by Crédit Aurore for the short-term deposits of retail customers across the European Union. The interest rate is currently 3.00 percent per annum, variable and adjusted in line with money-market conditions and the European Central Bank's key rates; rate changes are notified to customers in advance. Interest is calculated daily and credited annually on 31 December. Depending on the customer's country of tax residence, interest may be subject to local withholding tax or must be declared in the customer's annual tax return; Crédit Aurore provides an annual interest certificate to support reporting obligations. There is no upper limit on the amount that may be deposited, although a preferential rate applies up to EUR 100,000. Funds are available at any time, without notice period or penalty. There are no opening, maintenance or closing fees, and the minimum opening deposit is EUR 10. Deposits are protected by the national deposit guarantee scheme of the booking entity up to EUR 100,000 per depositor and per institution, a level harmonised across the European Union. The Aurore Savings account is designed as a liquid, low-risk reserve and can be opened entirely online and linked to the current account, with transfers between the two settling instantly. It is well suited to building an emergency fund while keeping money fully accessible.

The Aurore Visa Classic is an international payment card available with immediate or deferred debit at the holder's choice, priced at EUR 44 per year. It allows payments worldwide wherever the Visa network is accepted, as well as cash withdrawals at ATMs. Default limits are EUR 3,000 of payments over a rolling thirty days and EUR 800 of withdrawals over seven days, adjustable up or down from the mobile app subject to the bank's approval. The card supports contactless payment up to EUR 50 per transaction, with strong customer authentication under the second Payment Services Directive (PSD2) applied to online payments via mobile notification. Included insurance covers medical assistance and repatriation while travelling abroad, together with cover in case of loss or theft of means of payment. A purchase protection and a winter-sports cover are not included in this product line. Payments and withdrawals outside the euro area are subject to a currency conversion fee of 2.50 percent of the transaction amount. In case of loss or theft, the holder must block the card without delay via the round-the-clock emergency line. The holder's liability for fraudulent transactions made before the card is blocked is limited to EUR 50 under the EU payment-services framework, and is nil for unauthorised transactions after blocking. The card is renewed automatically every two years and is compatible with Apple Pay and Google Pay.

The Aurore Visa Premier is Crédit Aurore's premium card, priced at EUR 134 per year and included free of charge in the Aurore Premium Package. It is aimed at customers with regular net monthly income above EUR 1,800. Standard limits reach EUR 6,000 of payments over thirty days and EUR 1,500 of withdrawals over seven days, adjustable instantly from the app. The card offers a comprehensive range of insurance and assistance: trip cancellation and interruption cover up to EUR 5,000, winter-sports cover, liability abroad, travel accident cover up to EUR 310,000, as well as purchase protection and an extended warranty on goods paid for with the card. Medical assistance and repatriation are covered with no excess. Through the Visa Premier programme the holder gains access to a concierge service and to airport lounges. Contactless payment is capped at EUR 50 per transaction and strong customer authentication under PSD2 applies to online transactions. The currency conversion fee outside the euro area is reduced to 2.00 percent. In the event of an incident, the holder benefits from a priority blocking line open around the clock. The Visa Premier works with Apple Pay and Google Pay. The exact insurance limits and detail of the guarantees are set out in the insurance terms handed over at subscription, in line with pre-contractual information requirements under EU consumer law.

The Aurore Consumer Loan is an unsecured personal loan to finance a personal project, a purchase or home improvements, in amounts from EUR 1,000 to EUR 75,000, repayable over a term of 12 to 84 months. The fixed annual percentage rate of charge (APR) ranges from 5.90 percent to 12.90 percent depending on the borrower's credit profile, the amount and the term, in compliance with the EU Consumer Credit Directive. As a representative example, a loan of EUR 10,000 over 48 months at a fixed APR of 6.90 percent results in 48 monthly instalments of EUR 238.71, giving a total amount payable of EUR 11,458, excluding optional insurance. The borrower has a statutory right of withdrawal of fourteen calendar days from the signing of the agreement. Every application is subject to a creditworthiness assessment, which may include consultation of national credit registers. Early repayment is possible at any time; a compensation capped at 1 percent of the amount repaid early may apply where the remaining term exceeds one year, otherwise 0.50 percent. Optional payment-protection insurance can cover death, disability and loss of employment. The online simulation is free and without commitment. Crédit Aurore complies with pre-contractual information duties and provides the Standard European Consumer Credit Information sheet before any contract is concluded, so that the customer can compare offers across the single market.

The Aurore Mortgage finances the purchase of a main or second home or a buy-to-let property, as well as construction and major works. Fixed rates start at 3.45 percent over 15 years, 3.65 percent over 20 years and 3.85 percent over 25 years for the strongest profiles, excluding insurance and fees. Repayment terms range from 7 to 25 years, exceptionally 27 years for new-build property. Crédit Aurore generally requires a personal contribution of at least 10 percent of the property price to cover acquisition and guarantee costs, but examines applications without a deposit on a case-by-case basis. The debt-service ratio should not exceed 35 percent of net income, insurance included, in line with macro-prudential recommendations. Mortgage protection insurance covering death, total and permanent loss of autonomy, disability and incapacity is required in practice, and under EU rules the borrower is free to choose an external insurer rather than the lender's group policy. The guarantee may take the form of a mortgage charge or an equivalent security. Early repayment gives rise to compensation capped by law and disclosed up front. A binding loan offer valid for at least thirty days is provided, together with the European Standardised Information Sheet (ESIS) required by the Mortgage Credit Directive, and the customer benefits from a mandatory reflection period before acceptance.

Crédit Aurore offers SEPA and international transfers from online banking and the mobile app. A standard SEPA credit transfer in euros to a beneficiary in the SEPA area is free of charge and executed within one business day; a SEPA instant transfer is credited in under ten seconds, around the clock and every day of the year, at no surcharge up to EUR 100,000 per operation in line with the EU Instant Payments Regulation. SEPA transfers can be set up as one-off or standing orders, free of charge. Default transfer limits are EUR 10,000 per operation and EUR 30,000 per rolling month, which can be raised on request after enhanced identity verification. International transfers outside the SEPA area, denominated in foreign currency, are routed through the SWIFT network and charged at 0.10 percent of the amount with a minimum of EUR 15 and a maximum of EUR 80, plus exchange fees and, where applicable, correspondent-bank charges according to the cost-sharing option chosen (SHA, OUR or BEN). Execution of an international transfer typically takes one to four business days. All online operations are subject to strong customer authentication under PSD2. The customer receives a confirmation detailing the amount, the fees, the exchange rate applied and the value date, in line with the transparency obligations of the Payment Services Directive. Under PSD2, the customer is also informed of the maximum execution time before initiating the payment.

A Crédit Aurore payment card must be blocked without delay as soon as loss, theft or fraudulent use is identified. The blocking service is reachable around the clock and every day of the year on the dedicated emergency number, and the card can also be blocked directly in the mobile app through the instant-freeze function, which immediately suspends all payments and withdrawals. The in-app freeze is reversible if the card is found, whereas a telephone block results in permanent cancellation and the issuing of a new card, delivered within five to seven business days. As soon as the block is registered, the holder receives a reference number and a written confirmation. For fraudulent transactions, the holder's liability is limited to EUR 50 for payments made before the block using the card data, and is nil for fraud without the physical presence of the card or after the block, under the EU payment-services framework. Any unauthorised transaction must be reported within a maximum of thirteen months from the debit date. Crédit Aurore refunds disputed unauthorised amounts immediately, unless there are reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the holder. In case of theft it is recommended to file a police report and keep the receipt. An express replacement card can be dispatched within twenty-four hours for a fee of EUR 18. The holder should also review recent transactions and report any further suspicious activity to the bank.

text: Crédit Aurore Customer Service supports retail customers through several channels. The telephone line is open Monday to Friday from 8 am to 8 pm and Saturday from 9 am to 5 pm, excluding public holidays. The card loss and theft blocking line, by contrast, is reachable around the clock and every day of the year. The secure messaging service in online banking lets customers exchange messages with an adviser, with a commitment to respond within one business day. The Tessera conversational assistant, available in English, French and German, answers common questions about products, operations and regulation instantly, and routes sensitive or complex requests to a human adviser. Physical branches receive customers by appointment booked online. Service levels guarantee an average telephone answer time of under three minutes and the handling of a written complaint within ten business days, with a maximum legal response time to a complaint of two months. If a disagreement persists, the customer can refer the matter free of charge to the banking ombudsman, whose contact details appear on account statements and the website, in line with EU consumer alternative dispute resolution rules. Accessible channels are available for customers with disabilities. Every complaint is logged and acknowledged within forty-eight hours. Customers can also manage most service requests, including limit changes and statement downloads, directly through self-service in the app.

The general terms of the Crédit Aurore account govern the contractual relationship between the bank and the holder of a payment account. The account agreement is concluded for an indefinite period and can be terminated by the customer at any time, free of charge and without giving reasons, with the credit balance returned and means of payment to be handed back. The bank may terminate the agreement subject to two months' notice, except in the case of a serious breach by the customer justifying immediate closure. Incident fees are capped and disclosed: a rejected direct debit for insufficient funds is charged at a regulated amount, and fees applying to unauthorised overdrafts are limited and itemised on statements. Interest on an unauthorised overdraft is calculated at the prevailing debit rate. The bank provides an annual statement of fees in line with the Payment Accounts Directive, allowing customers to compare costs across providers. Any change to the fee schedule is notified at least two months before it takes effect; the absence of objection counts as acceptance, and the customer may terminate free of charge before the change applies. The customer has a right to a basic payment account and to facilitated switching between banks under EU law. Deposits on the account are protected by the deposit guarantee scheme of the booking entity up to EUR 100,000 per depositor and per institution.

The Aurore Premium Package is a bundled offer of banking services priced at EUR 14.90 per month, that is EUR 178.80 per year, designed for customers who want to group their essential needs at an advantageous rate. The package includes free maintenance of the Aurore Current Account, a Visa Premier card with all of its insurance and assistance, unlimited free withdrawals at all ATMs in the euro area, free SEPA and instant transfers, and SMS alerts at no surcharge. It also includes means-of-payment insurance covering all the household's cards and chequebooks in case of loss, theft or fraudulent use, insurance against the loss of keys and identity papers, and legal protection for private life. Subscribers benefit from a rate reduced by 0.20 percentage points on the Aurore Consumer Loan and a 50 percent discount on the arrangement fees of mortgages. The Aurore Points loyalty programme grants a multiplier of 1.5 on points earned. A dedicated adviser is reachable on a direct line and telephone handling is given priority. The saving compared with subscribing to the services separately amounts to roughly EUR 90 per year. The package can be cancelled at any time subject to thirty days' notice, with no penalty. A detailed comparison of the services is provided before subscription, in line with rules on tying and bundling under EU consumer and banking law.

Crédit Aurore distributes, in partnership with authorised insurers, home and motor insurance contracts for its retail customers. Home multi-risk insurance covers civil liability, fire, water damage, theft, glass breakage and natural disasters, with a basic formula from EUR 9.90 per month for a two-room flat and a standard excess of EUR 150 per claim. Options strengthen the cover: protection of portable devices, replacement-value cover of furniture, home emergency assistance and holiday-let cover. Motor insurance offers three levels, third-party, third-party-plus and comprehensive, from EUR 28 per month depending on the driver's profile, the vehicle and the geographic zone; it includes zero-kilometre assistance, driver cover up to EUR 500,000 and a replacement vehicle under the comprehensive formula. Subscribing online produces an immediate quote and the possibility of a 5 percent discount for taking out both contracts together. In line with EU consumer law, the customer has a fourteen-day right of withdrawal for distance contracts and can, after the first year, cancel at any time. The insurance product information document, the pre-contractual information and the general terms are provided before the contract is concluded, ensuring the customer understands the scope of cover, the exclusions and the claims process before committing. Claims can be filed online or via a round-the-clock hotline, with supporting documents and photos uploaded directly through the app, and the customer can track the status of the claim at every stage until settlement.

The Aurore Points loyalty programme rewards the use of Crédit Aurore products and services. Every euro spent with a Visa Classic or Visa Premier card at partner merchants earns one point, and a euro spent outside partners earns half a point. Holders of the Aurore Premium Package benefit from a multiplier of 1.5 on all their points. Points are credited monthly to the loyalty account viewable in the mobile app and have no direct monetary value. They can be converted into purchase vouchers at partner brands, into donations to listed charities, into a reduction on card fees, or into entry to prize draws. The conversion rate is 1,000 points for a EUR 5 purchase voucher. Points expire twenty-four months after they are earned if not used, with the oldest balance debited first. The programme is free and enrolment is automatic for any payment-card holder. No payment data is shared with partners without the customer's explicit consent, in line with the General Data Protection Regulation; the customer can object at any time to profiling for the personalisation of offers. The programme terms are available online and may change subject to one month's prior notice. The customer can end participation at any time with no impact on their banking products, and any unused points are settled according to the published conversion table before closure.
